parameters.description: boulder of dark stone with chunks of copper-brown ore embedded in it, black outline, warm earthy tones, NES-era retro pixel art, few colors

hit.animationDescription: the boulder shudders and rocks slightly to one side and back from a pick blow, settling still, no particles, no effects

down.animationDescription: the boulder cracks and slowly settles and sinks down into a low heap of broken dark stone rubble on the ground, the ore keeping its copper colour as it breaks up, no flash, no particles, no effects

endFrame.editDescription: the boulder has been mined away: only a low heap of broken dark stone rubble remains on the ground, with no ore left in it; empty transparent space above the heap

replaced.description: the boulder cracks apart and its upper part crumbles down into a low heap of broken dark stone rubble on the ground, the ore chunks breaking away, no particles, no effects
replaced.why: Frame 2 flashed the ore white, an effect by another name, and frames 6 and 7 left stray pixels detached from the heap. Made again in the same group (animation 5cacf91c-5515-4d6c-b650-983cdfe92cf8, replaced by 6b77f3bc-f502-4c68-9561-6c0188c2f64b); the kept take still lightens the ore on frames 1 and 2 and leaves one stray pixel on frame 7, accepted by the agent and flagged to the owner.
